units.source_text: 大雨滂沱之时，母夫人从京中赶来。

en.t: As the rain poured down in torrents, her mother hurried from the capital.

units.source_text: 她哭道：“你倘在我眼前死去，虽然我也十分悲痛，但因死生乃世之常事，人间还有其例。

en.t: Weeping, she said, "If you had died before my eyes, I would still have been deeply grieved, but life and death are the ordinary way of the world, and there are examples of it among people.

units.source_text: 如今尸骨不存，叫我何以为心？”

en.t: But now not even your remains are left; how am I to bear this in my heart?"

units.source_text: 浮舟为了匂亲王纠缠而忧愁苦闷等情，母夫人全然不知。

en.t: Her mother knew nothing at all of Ukifune's sorrow and anguish over Prince Niou's persistent pursuit of her.

units.source_text: 因此她万没想到她会投水自尽。

en.t: For that reason, she never imagined that Ukifune would throw herself into the water and take her own life.

units.source_text: 她疑心浮舟被鬼吞食，或者被狐狸精取去了。

en.t: She suspected that Ukifune had been devoured by a demon, or perhaps carried off by a fox spirit.

units.source_text: 因为她记得古代小说中记载着这种怪异事件。

en.t: For she remembered that strange incidents of this kind were recorded in old tales.

units.source_text: 东猜西想了一会，终于想起了她一向担心的二公主：

en.t: After turning over all sorts of guesses in her mind for a while, she finally thought of the Second Princess, about whom she had long been worried:

units.source_text: 她身边或许有心地不良的乳母，闻知薰大将将迎接浮舟入京，认为深可痛恨，

en.t: perhaps there was an ill-intentioned nurse at the princess's side who, on hearing that General Kaoru meant to bring Ukifune to the capital, had felt it deeply hateful,

units.source_text: 便暗中勾结了这里的仆人下此毒手，亦未可知。

en.t: and might have secretly joined with a servant here to commit this cruel deed.

units.source_text: 于是她怀疑这里的仆人，问道：“有没有新进来的陌生的仆人？”

en.t: So she suspected the servants here and asked, "Has any unfamiliar servant newly come in?"

units.source_text: 这里地点荒僻，住不惯的人一刻也做不牢，

en.t: This place is remote and desolate, and anyone not used to living here cannot endure it for even a moment,

units.source_text: 总是推说‘我去一下就来’，便卷卷铺盖回乡去了。”

en.t: but always makes some excuse, saying, 'I will just go out and be right back,' then rolls up their bedding and goes home to the countryside."

units.source_text: 这确是实情，本来在此任职的人，也有几个人辞职而去。

en.t: This was indeed the truth; even among those who had originally served here, several had resigned and left.

units.source_text: 所以这时候山庄中仆人甚少。

en.t: Thus at this time there were very few servants in the mountain villa.

units.source_text: 侍从等回想小姐近几日来的神情，记得她常常哭着说“我真想死了”。

en.t: The attendants thought back over the young lady's manner in recent days and remembered that she had often wept and said, "I truly want to die."
